propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, honoring effective disables, project applicability, activated DET criteria, and explicit budgets.
Round A must select base reviewer and each criterion exactly once with effective disabled/non-applicable criteria recording reason provenance and executing zero times.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced with over-budget units shed before calls; zero is schema-invalid; omission leaves no implicit cap.

After one local criterion call failure, retain earlier successes and continue independent criteria; blocking-capable missing coverage returns unsigned INDETERMINATE; advisory-only missing coverage may pass.

Code-review response, base-reviewer payload, one-hop Round B path, per-overlay context, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints must remain unchanged from pre-cutover contract.
Versioned safe discovery trace must persist in internal code-review journal without trace fields added to review response or status projection.
